content: IPv4/IPv6 TS libs compared via npm+GitHub: ip-address (beaugunderson) v10.2.0, 612 GH stars, zero deps, 270KB unpacked, browser-safe, provides startAddress/endAddress/subnetMaskAddress/wildcardMask/reverseForm/canonicalForm - directly covers Packetory's subnet calculator output list. ip-num v1.6.1, 175 stars, zero-dep, provides CIDR range/split but no built-in broadcast/wildcard/reverseDNS helpers (would need to build them). netmask v2.1.1, 253 stars, now supports both IPv4+IPv6, 26KB, simpler API, no reverse-DNS helper. Recommendation: ip-address for feature completeness matching brief's required output fields.
